Note No. 1: The Company has granted Employee Stock Appreciation Rights (ESARs) and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) to eligible employees under its respective schemes, namely the 'BCML Employees Stock Appreciation Rights Plan 2023' and the 'BCML Restricted Stock Unit Scheme 2025,' both of which have been approved by the shareholders of the Company and disclosures have been made accordingly. Further, as advised by the National Stock Exchange of India Limited, we have taken the closing price as on 30th September, 2026 for calculating Outstanding No. of ESOPs to be mentioned in Column No. (XC).
However, while calculating “Outstanding No. of ESOPs Granted” the following has not been considered:
1. 11,280 ESARs has not been considered as the same were exercised by the eligible employee during the quarter pursuant to 'BCML Employees Stock Appreciation Rights Plan 2023’ and the same are pending for allotment as on 30th September, 2026.
